name: Locust Shade (Hòe Âm Tam Kiện)

bonuses.rule: For each 10 s you are Composed, your wards gain 5 % strength, and the gain falls away by a fifth each pulse when you are not Composed; your first damaging art after it is a sure hit.

story: The locust seal of the clan, the knot from his father's rope and the dye works' robe: everything the Tiêu kept while they waited eighty years for the cave.

name: Twin Bridges (Song Kiều Tam Kiện)

bonuses.effect: Pillar in the Flood (Lưu Trung Trụ)
bonuses.rule: While above half health you gain delay and push immunity, and every fifth hit you block takes a toll: the attacker loses 3 % of its max linh lực and you gain it.

story: The toll seal his father cut in 900, the pillar face and the flood coat: the Ôn bridges as one man wears them.

name: The Old Hall (Cựu Đường Tam Bảo)

bonuses.effect: The Swallow Returns to Its Nest (Yến Hoàn Cựu Sào)
bonuses.rule: Every third Wood art you cast triggers a follow-up soul-ink hit (c = 1.4) against the same foe.

story: The three things the Tạ carried out of their old hall in 470: the fan, the ink jade and the hall's seal. The head holds the fan and the seal, his elder son the jade; the set is whole only in one pair of hands, which by custom means the next head. Tạ Cựu Đường has not given his son the fan, and his son has not asked.

name: The Granary (Thương Lẫm Tam Kiện)

bonuses.rule: Every 10 s of a fight you store a seed; when you would fall below a fifth of your health, all stored seeds are eaten at once and each heals 8 % of your health.

story: The bell rung at the first sheaf, the granary seal and the seed gourd: the Lục harvest, which the Tower counts before anyone else's.

name: The Hỗ Fleet (Hỗ Gia Thuyền Đội)

bonuses.effect: Leave With the Tide (Tùy Triều Khứ)
bonuses.rule: Once a fight, when you fall below half health, you step away: incoming damage is reduced by 99 % for 2 s, you regain 10 % of your max linh lực, and your next art is a sure hit.

story: His father's ring, his mother's sailcloth and the mirror the house reads the weather in: the marriage that made the white sands a trading town, worn by its son.

name: Reeling Thread (Trừu Ti Song Kiện)

bonuses.rule: When a foe carries 6 or more of your Burn stacks, your next needle art pulls them tight and consumes all Fire debuff stacks to deal immediate fire damage (c = 0.114 per stack).

story: The house's needle and the thimble of its first head: they pass together to the best reeler, never to the eldest child.
